description: This file defines functions related to parsing rebase configuration values in Git, specifically interpreting textual rebase modes such as 'merges', 'interactive', and 'preserve'. It includes logic to determine the rebase type based on input strings and handles different recognized and unrecognized values.

methods.name: enum:rebase_type rebase_parse_value(const char * value)
methods.description: Parses the input string to determine the rebase type, returning constants like REBASE_FALSE, REBASE_TRUE, REBASE_MERGES, REBASE_INTERACTIVE, REBASE_PRESERVE, or REBASE_INVALID based on the value.
